name: Zhejiang Orient Financial Holdings Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Orient Financial Holdings Group Co., Ltd. operates primarily as a foreign trade entity within the People's Republic of China, engaging in a broad spectrum of activities. The company facilitates the export of various textile products, including knitted, woven, and general garments, alongside home textile goods. On the import side, it procures specialized professional equipment and a range of mechanical and electrical products, such as machinery for textiles, dyeing, printing, medical applications, solar energy, and water treatment. Its import portfolio also includes raw materials like wool, cotton, and diverse textile chemical fibers. Beyond traditional trade, the group is involved in bulk commodity transactions. It delivers comprehensive professional services to its clientele, encompassing export and import assistance, agent purchasing, customs declaration, settlement processing, and logistics management. Furthermore, Zhejiang Orient Financial Holdings extends its operations into the financial sector, offering services such as financial leasing, asset management, and industrial finance. A significant part of its business also lies in real estate development, covering a diverse array of properties, from residential and commercial to educational, tourism, and elder care facilities. The company, established in 1988 and headquartered in Hangzhou, PRC, was formerly recognized as Zhejiang Orient Holdings Co., Ltd.
